payload.description: How many people are on Norwich's housing register, and how that has moved. The consultation page says around 4,000 people are waiting for social housing and that the council takes over 1,200 housing enquiries a month, but gives no date and no source for either, and we found no published register statistics to check them against.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 7 September 2026
